blocks.title: Electric potential difference
blocks.text: Do nuqton ke darmiyan electric potential difference un ke darmiyan charge le jane mein fi ikai charge kiya gaya kaam hai: V = VB - VA = WAB / qo = dU / qo (16.1). Is ki SI ikai volt hai: 1 V = 1 J / 1 C (16.2).

Volt ko kilovolt ya millivolt mein badla ja sakta hai. Potential difference electric field se dV = E dd (16.3) ke zariye jura hai: electric field faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki sharah hai, E = -dV/dd (16.4). Manfi nishan batata hai ke field zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf hota hai; yani kisi nuqte par electric field wahan potential gradient ka manfi hai. Yaksan field ke liye yeh E = V/d (16.5) ho jata hai. Yun do nuqton ka potential difference field ki taqat aur un ke faasle ke mutanasib hai: taqatwar field potential ko tezi se girata hai. Fig 16.1 do charged plates ke darmiyan yaksan field ke khilaf musbat test charge qo ko A se B tak le jana dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar musbat plate aur neeche manfi plate, darmiyan neeche ki taraf mutawazi field lines E. Test charge qo (+) manfi plate ke qareeb nuqte A aur musbat plate ke qareeb nuqte B ke darmiyan; sabz teer A se B ki taraf harkat dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.1: Charged plates ke darmiyan yaksan (uniform) electric field; test charge qo ko A se B le jaya gaya (kitab ki Figure 16.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 6 V ki battery 0.3 cm door do mutawazi copper plates se jori gayi hai. Un ke darmiyan electric field maloom karein. Hal: dV = 6 V aur dd = 0.3 cm = 0.003 m, is liye E = dV/dd = 6 V / 0.003 m = 2000 N C^-1 (jo 2000 V m^-1 ke barabar hai).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Agarche la-mehdood faasle (infinity) ke nuqton ko sifar potential par mana jata hai, amalan zameen ko sifar potential par mana jata hai. Is liye kisi nuqte ka mutlaq potential zameen ke hawale se napa jata hai.

blocks.prompt: E = -dV/dd mein manfi nishan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke electric field us simt mein hota hai jidhar potential ghatta hai (zyada se kam potential ki taraf).

items: E = -dV/dd (field = potential gradient ka manfi); yaksan field E = V/d.
